title: Debt and Drop
premise: Mara Coldharbour, a disgraced intelligence analyst, notices that Flight 4471 has been erased from every database while still airborne — and that the only surviving manifest lists her estranged brother as a passenger. Pulled back into the service by a handler who once burned her, Mara races to reconstruct the flight's true fate, discovering a covert extradition deal between three governments that required the plane to never have existed. With an assassin closing in and border checkpoints about to rotate shifts, Mara must choose between exposing the truth and protecting the brother who betrayed her; she gets the evidence out at dawn, at the cost of her brother's freedom and her own reinstatement.
about_author: Sable Kavanagh is the pen name of a former aviation logistics consultant who spent a decade inside customs corridors and data centers few civilians ever see. They write thrillers about people who discover that paperwork is the most dangerous weapon of all.

chapters.title: Ghost Altitude
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Working a dead-end private contract, Mara spots an anomaly: Flight 4471 exists on radar feeds but nowhere else. When she pings old colleagues, one warns her to stop before hanging up. The beat is cold dread — the first hint that the rules she spent ten years obeying were always someone else's fiction.

chapters.title: The Manifest That Wasn't
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. A leaked fragment of the passenger list surfaces: her brother Tomas, missing for three years, was aboard 4471. Her handler, Ilsa Vane, offers reinstatement in exchange for quiet cooperation. Emotional beat: hope curdling into suspicion as Mara realizes both the leak and the offer are too convenient.

chapters.title: Three Flags, One Grave
chapters.summary: Alternating POV with Vane. Mara traces the flight path through two countries' air-traffic archives and finds coordinated deletions — a tri-national operation. Vane, meanwhile, reports to a superior that Mara is 'manageable.' The beat is vertigo: Mara sees the machinery for the first time, and it sees her back.

chapters.title: Checkpoint Arithmetic
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Following a courier trail, Mara learns the plane carried a prisoner being illegally extradited — and that Tomas was the escort who let him escape mid-flight, forcing the erasure. Border shift changes in nine hours will seal every crossing. Beat: loyalty vs. truth begins its real war inside her.

chapters.title: The Assassin's Ledger
chapters.summary: Assassin Corven's POV. Corven has erased four people connected to 4471 and adds Mara to the ledger. Told with chilling professionalism, this chapter shows the cost of each deletion — including one target who begged with his family's names. Beat: the reader learns the enemy is methodical, not monstrous, which is worse.

chapters.title: Ten Years of Rewritten Rules
chapters.summary: Mara's POV, flashback-laced. Cornered after a safehouse burns, Mara confronts why she was bounced from three agencies: each time, she refused to falsify a record. Vane admits she engineered Mara's firings to keep her raw and usable. Beat: betrayal, but also a strange liberation — Mara owes the system nothing now.

chapters.title: Love Against Duty
chapters.summary: Dual POV. Mara finds Tomas alive in a border-town clinic; he confesses he traded his silence for her safety years ago. Corven closes in, forcing them to move during the checkpoint shift change. Beat: tenderness under gunfire — love asserted not as refuge but as a decision made while running.

chapters.title: The Weight of Inheritance
chapters.summary: Tomas's POV. He reveals their father's old smuggling ledgers hold the encryption keys to the flight's black-box backup — an inheritance neither wanted. Corven intercepts them at a rail yard; Vane's team arrives, and loyalties fracture in real time. Beat: the past stops being backstory and becomes ammunition.

chapters.title: Shift Change
chapters.summary: Mara's POV, climax. At the border checkpoint, Mara broadcasts the reconstructed flight record across three governments' channels simultaneously, making suppression impossible. Corven has her in his sights but hesitates — his ledger requires certainty, and she has just destroyed it. Beat: triumph priced in blood; Tomas surrenders to buy the transmission time.

chapters.title: Debt Paid in Full
chapters.summary: Mara's POV, resolution. Weeks later, inquiries open in two capitals; Vane resigns rather than testify; Corvan vanishes, ledger closed. Mara declines reinstatement, choosing independent oversight work instead, visiting Tomas monthly through glass. Final beat: bittersweet clarity — she finally owns her own record, and it cost everything she inherited to write it.
